questions.question: When the twelve tribal leaders of Israel brought an offering before the LORD at the tabernacle, what did they bring?

answers.text: Six covered carts and twelve oxen

questions.question: When Moses gave out carts and oxen to the Levite families, why did the Kohathites get none?

answers.text: They carried the holy objects on their shoulders
They camped too far from the tabernacle
They already had carts of their own

questions.question: When the twelve leaders of Israel brought offerings to dedicate the altar, how often did the LORD say one leader should present his?
When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, where did the voice speaking to him come from?

answers.text: Above the mercy seat on the ark
Beside the altar in the courtyard
Behind the curtain at the door
